prose: SiliconANGLE reports that PicoJool, a startup backed by former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger, raised $27.5M in a Series A led by Socratic Partners with participation from Hudson River Trading, bringing its total funding to $39.5M after a $12M seed led by Gelsinger's Playground Global last November.
PicoJool targets the strain AI data centers put on infrastructure, positioning its technology to ease the growing power and connectivity demands of AI build-outs.
highlights: PicoJool raises $27.5M Series A led by Socratic Partners
Backed by former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger (Playground Global led the seed)
Mission: ease the infrastructure strain of AI data centers
